basic_details.job_title: IISER Thiruvananthapuram Project Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER Thiruvananthapuram) has notified 1 vacancy for the Project Scientist-1 post on a Contract basis. The appointment is for 1 year extendable to 0.5 year on satisfactory performance. The candidate qualification required for Project Scientist-1 is a Doctoral degree in Physics, or candidates with a thesis submitted can also apply, with specialisation on condensed matter physics. how_to_apply: Email your CV to Dr. Deepshikha Jaiswal-Nagar at [email protected].
Mention the subject line strictly as "Application for Project Scientist-I: your name".

If shortlisted for the interview, submit a printed copy of the application form signed and dated by the applicant, a recent passport size photograph, one photocopy each of all relevant certificates in support of age, qualification, and experience, along with originals of all certificates for verification.

content_sections.heading: IISER Thiruvananthapuram Project Scientist-1 at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram
Office of the Dean, Research Development and Consultancies
AI-based smart sensors for rapid and real-time detection of ppm level H2 leaks in hydrogen storage and distribution structures
1 year extendable to 0.5 year on satisfactory performance

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential educational qualification and meet the age limit prescribed by the funding agency. Essential Qualification: Doctoral degree in Physics. Candidates with thesis submitted can also apply. Specialisation should be on condensed matter physics. Desirable Qualifications: Prior experience in depositing thin films using high vacuum deposition systems and gas sensing. Age Limit: Maximum 33 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship amount of Rs. 58,000 per month plus HRA. The tenure of the post is 1 year, which is extendable to an additional 0.5 year based on satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Thiruvananthapuram Project Scientist-1
content_sections.text: Prepare your detailed CV. Email your CV to Dr. Deepshikha Jaiswal-Nagar at [email protected] . Mention the subject line strictly as "Application for Project Scientist-I: your name" . If shortlisted for the interview, submit a printed copy of the application form signed and dated by the applicant, a recent passport size photograph, one photocopy each of all relevant certificates in support of age, qualification, and experience, along with originals of all certificates for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates is conducted by a Selection Committee constituted for this purpose if the number of applications received is high, based on qualifications and experience over and above the minimum prescribed. Information regarding the interviews will be sent by email to all shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Project Scientist-1 position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is strictly on a contract basis for a tenure of 1 year, which is extendable to 0.5 year on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the base fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate receives Rs. 58,000 per month plus HRA as stated in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What specific subject specialisation is required in the doctoral degree?
faq.answer: The applicant's doctoral degree in Physics must have a specialisation in condensed matter physics.

faq.question: Q4. What must be included in the email subject line when applying?
faq.answer: Applicants must use the exact subject line: "Application for Project Scientist-I: your name".
